description: This skill guides clinicians in sharing decision‑making when selecting an antiepileptic drug (AED) by providing quantitative estimates of each drug’s expected weight effect. It is triggered when a clinician asks how to discuss weight‑change risks when choosing an AED or what information to provide on weight effects of specific agents such as valproate versus lamotrigine.
